name: Vannaka
notes: Base points were raised from 4 to 8 in the Summer Sweep Up update (27 August 2025).
Combat level requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape (99 Slayer).
Commonly assigns tasks of 60-120 kills and can assign difficult monsters such as abyssal demons.
Located in Edgeville Dungeon east of the Wilderness gate; entering via the Cooks' Guild entrance requires a brass key.
